status: draft — not reviewed; do not launch before privacy and methodology review
title: Indian Taxpayer Voice survey
description: A short, anonymous survey about the concerns of people who pay taxes in India. It takes about five minutes.
welcome: Thank you for taking part. This survey is voluntary and anonymous. It is not an official government survey, and taking part does not provide any financial, insurance or other benefit. Please do not include your name, contact details or other identifying information in any answer.
end_text: Thank you. Your response has been recorded. Aggregated results are published on the Indian Taxpayer Voice website once enough responses are received.

consent.text: I am 18 or older, I have read the privacy notice, and I agree that my anonymous answers may be included in published aggregate statistics.

questions.text: Which state or union territory do you live in?

options.DH: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

questions.text: Which broad sector do you mainly work in?
questions.help: If you are not currently working, choose "Not currently employed".

questions.text: What best describes how you mainly earn your income?
Which range best describes your annual individual income before tax?
questions.help: Broad ranges only. We never ask for your exact income.

questions.text: Which of these are significant concerns for you? Select all that apply.

options.JOBLOSS: Income protection if I lose my job
options.HEALTH: Affording medical treatment or health insurance
options.PUBSVC: Quality of public services relative to taxes paid

questions.text: If your main income stopped today, roughly how long could you cover essential expenses?
Do you have health cover that would pay for a hospital stay?

options.PERS: Yes, a policy I bought myself

questions.text: Which improvements would you prioritise? Choose up to three.

options.UNEMP: An unemployment insurance or income-support scheme
options.SPEND: Clearer reporting of how taxes are spent
options.PUBSVC: Better public services such as hospitals, schools and transport

questions.text: Is there anything else you would like to tell us? (optional)
questions.help: Please do not include names, phone numbers, email addresses, employer names or other details that could identify you or anyone else. Comments are never published word for word.
